description: Full-page contact form with navbar and footer. LandingTemplate wrapping a centered form with name/email/subject/message fields and success state.

navbar.description: Navbar configuration — logoText, links, ctaText, ctaHref

subheading.description: Subheading below heading. Default: 'Have a question or need help?...'

supportEmail.description: Direct contact email shown as a fallback link

subjects.description: Subject dropdown options. Default: billing, bug, feature, other.

onSubmit.type: (data: { name: string; email: string; subject: string; message: string }) => Promise<void>
onSubmit.description: Async submit handler. Throws on error.
